tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google Cloud shows artificial intelligence tools for Indian small and medium businesses at Cloud Day India 2026, confirmed by The Economic Times.
Pentagon and OpenAI expand ChatGPT Mil with memory, document generation, and training capabilities for military users, reported by AFCEA International.
Malaysia seizes 30 artificial intelligence chip servers worth RM49.5M in transit at KLIA Customs, in the fifth case this year, confirmed by Newswav.
Ceva launches next-generation NeuPro NPUs with 2X artificial intelligence throughput and 50 percent better efficiency, expanding into artificial intelligence infrastructure, confirmed by TradingView.
Test Triangle joins Microsoft artificial intelligence Cloud Partner Program for Azure, Copilot, and Dynamics 365 services, reported by EIN Presswire.
Free every hour.
